featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Jayes & Kajal Shah in Santacruz. Please avoid them at all costs — they completely ruined my wedding outfits. The fittings were terrible, the designs looked nothing like what was promised, and despite repeated requests, they refused to take responsibility. featured_reviews.name: Bomi Manekshaw
featured_reviews.review_text:
The big plus point is that it has some car parking space. But, not half as pleasant as the one in the Army Navy Building at Fort. The floor space is smaller and the ambiance as the friendly customer service approach missing.

The trial rooms are considerably mismanaged. Long ques for trial and I'm sure disguised missed opportunities from customers who didn't think it worth their money to wait in these long queues. 🤷🏻

The floor manager also seemed to find it difficult to manage so many issues together. A customer pointed out a tiny lizard on one of the dresses which he brushed aside refusing to acknowledge it's presence till another customer requested him to jerk the dress and asked him to acknowledge when it fell off. A sensible, emotionally intelligent person would have immediately apologized to any customer instead of just walking away as if to say " I'm too busy for any of this drama". Unfortunate! But that's our experience. 🙏🏻
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We apologise for your experience. Let us know more at westside@trent-tata.com so we can improve our service to your expectations! 💚 Westside

A comfortable place to shop for decent clothing. While the selection isn’t very extensive, the pricing is quite reasonable. Parking is limited, and getting to the basement parking can be a bit tricky—especially for larger cars—as the ramp is quite narrow and tight.

name: Shyamal & Bhumika
description:
Bhumika and Shyamal Shodhan are fashion designers from India. They believe that hand-made is a rare luxury we inherit, having their base in India. Their detailed workmanship is a reflection of the essence of India, its artisans and craft. Keeping alive a heritage through the medium of fashion creating collections for an equally passionate global muse.
The SHYAMAL & BHUMIKA brand stands for effortless luxury and a sense of accomplishment mastered from designing timeless outfits which can be handed over from generation to generation.
Shyamal & Bhumika’s collection retail from their flagship stores in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad and Los Angeles as well as their website .

featured_reviews.name: shivani jangid
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Shyamal & Bhumika for my wedding was one of the best decisions I made.The outfit felt like a dream, timeless, elegant, and crafted with such attention to detail. From the silhouettes to the intricate workmanship, everything reflected luxury with soul.

I felt confident, graceful, and truly myself in every ensemble. The team especially Nikita was warm, patient, and understood my vision perfectly, making the entire experience seamless and special.

Thank you, Shyamal & Bhumika, for creating my outfit that didn’t just dress me for my wedding, but became a part of my memories forever. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Chahat Saini
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of visiting your stunning Mumbai store at Kemps Corner, and I'm absolutely delighted to share my enchanting bridal journey experience. After exploring collections from top designers like Sabyasachi, Tarun Tahiliani, and Rimple & Harpreet, I chose Shyamal & Bhumika bridal lehenga, and it was a standout piece that truly wone me over.

The moment I entered the store, the staff's warm welcome and enthusiasm in showcasing their best bridal collection made me feel at home. I especially want to thank Dhanashree, Aanchal and Nidhi for their exceptional service and support throughout my journey. For any query or support Dhanashree was always available. My family, including my mom and sister, were equally impressed with the collection and the staff's courtesy, and they ended up buying outfits too!

I was also fortunate to meet Shyamal sir, and I personally shared my feedback with him. The entire experience was truly memorable, and your team's dedication to customer service made my special day even more special. Thank you for making it a moment I'll cherish forever!

featured_reviews.name: aahana patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Shyamal & Bhumika Mumbai store gave me the most incredible experience while finding my reception outfit. They helped me choose the perfect look and got everything done so quickly without compromising on quality. The craftsmanship was impeccable and the stitching was absolutely perfect. Everything fit like a dream.

A huge thank you to Dhanashree, who was so attentive, kind, and thoughtful throughout the process. She communicated clearly at every step and even surprised me with a matching purse for my special day, which was such a sweet and thoughtful touch.

I could not have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this store to anyone looking for something truly special.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Shyamal Bhumika lehnga as a groom's mother for the wedding was a perfect decision. I loved the lehnga the moment my eyes fell on it. The colour , the workmanship , the fitting was perfect. I felt like a bride myself - confident, elegant, graceful and regal. I have received so many complements - will cherish the experience for ever.
Thank you to the entire team for making me look beautiful for one of the most important occassions of my life - my son's wedding. Special thanks to Bhumika who was suprisingly at the store when I was deciding - she helped me make the decision effortlessly with her creative inputs.
Dhanashree from the team was especially helpful with her patient and warm demeanor through all the trials.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Hothi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had another fantastic experience thanks to Sagar Varyani. He is always professional, polite, attentive, helpful and incredibly prompt. I’ve placed orders with  Shyamal & Bhumika for the past few years and always had a great experience, and I’m so pleased to say it’s been exactly the same again this time with Sagar.

Sagar has made the whole process so easy and stress-free — communication is clear and helpful from start to finish, and nothing ever feels like too much trouble. It’s a pleasure dealing with someone so reliable and genuinely customer-focused and I feel I am in trusted hands.

The outfits are high-quality and beautifully presented, and the service throughout has been absolutely fantastic. You can really tell they take pride in what they do.

I wouldn’t hesitate to order again and highly recommend Sagar to anyone looking for great service and quality products.

featured_reviews.name: Ishika Bhanushali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Shyamal & Bhumika! The wedding outfit was everything I had hoped for—elegant, beautifully crafted, and fit like a dream.
A big thank you to Nikita, who was an absolute blessing through the entire process. She really understood what I was looking for. From suggestions to fittings, she made everything smooth and stress-free, and ensured every detail was perfect.
Thank you, Shyamal & Bhumika team, for creating something so memorable. Highly recommend to any bride looking for timeless,  wedding wear .

featured_reviews.name: niketa virani
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently wore a lehenga from Shyamal and bhumika and I felt absolutely beautiful in it. The fit, detailing, and finishing were just perfect. The craftsmanship truly reflects the effort and creativity behind the design. I received so many compliments! Highly recommend for anyone looking for something elegant and special.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Barad
featured_reviews.review_text: Nikita helped me find the perfect sangeet outfit. She was so receptive when even after I came back to the USA. The store was punctual in delivering the dress the exact time they predicted. They also took the blouse back and quickly did alterations when it didn't fit correctly. I would highly recommend this store and I hope to wear more Shyamal Bhumika outfits in the future!

name: Flirt
description:
Into contemporary styles and trends, the idea of Flirt started out as an exquisite boutique nestled right across the sea at Malabar Hills, Mumbai.

Fashion-forward trends coupled with the finest fabrics from Europe and the rest of the world, Flirt enables you to be dressed in sizzling haute couture minus the astronomical price tag.

We tailor some of the finest cuts and our collection covers the most sought-after fabrics such as pure chiffon, pure silk, pure crepe, velvet, satins and denim to name a few. We also have an array of plus sizes for the able-bodied woman.

name: Mayori Conscious Clothing - Women's Clothing Store
description:
Mayori Conscious Clothing Conscious Giving is a fresh international take on Jaipur hand block printing. We at Mayori are amalgamating traditional printing techniques with fine cotton fabrics and stitching in the modern silhouettes desired by the urban Indian woman of today who slips in and out of many roles effortlessly every day.
On every Mayori purchase, we support action on today’s most pressing human issues- malnutrition, women’s hygiene and sustainability. Under the “Conscious Giving” endeavour, Mayori pledges “YOU BUY ONE, WE GIVE ONE”. That is for every garment we sell we donate an item of utility/sustainable to our partner NGOs
